<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1110
Claimant:
Ethan Sharp
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
July 1, 2025
Claim received by phone from the claimant, who reports being rear-ended at a traffic light while stopped in their
vehicle. The claimant is not represented by an attorney and has agreed to provide a recorded statement.
August 7, 2025
Confirmed that the driver is named on the policy and that the policy was in force at the time of the reported collision.
Requested the police report and photos from the scene.
August 19, 2025
Police report and scene photos received. Responding officer and two independent witnesses confirm the claimant
was in the vehicle and that the collision occurred as described. The other driver has given a consistent account. Rear
damage on the claimant's vehicle appears largely consistent with the described impact.
October 31, 2025
Claimant reports neck pain and stiffness and has been evaluated and treated. The reported injury fits the type and
force of this kind of crash. Treatment has followed a typical course and symptoms have eased as the claimant
improved. No prior injury to the neck or upper back is known from records or the claimant's statements.
November 12, 2025
Follow-up recorded statement taken. The claimant added a few minor details, such as the exact position of a vehicle,
but the core account has not changed. A neighbor has mentioned seeing the vehicle with body damage some weeks
before the claimed date. This has not been verified, and no earlier damage to the vehicle is known from our records
or the repair history.
November 22, 2025
Reviewed the neighbor comment against the collision facts, phtoos and witness statements, which continue to
support the claimed accident. Will ask the neighbor for a short statement and check prior repair and inspection
records before closing the file.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
